entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm calling about Madarame's state.[n]For the time being, he hasn't suffered[n]a mental shutdown.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Other than that, his demeanor seems[n]to have softened a bit.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is that the change of heart?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I was curious and looked into[n]Kamoshida as well. It's as if he was[n]an entirely different person.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Will the same be true for Sensei?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I'm sorry to have taken your time.[n]That's all I wanted to tell you. Good—

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Oh. I'll try asking him about the black-[n]masked intruder from the Palace[n]when the time is right.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Goodbye then. This time for sure.
